answer: Mutual vouching, decaying budgets. Each agent stakes a vouch budget on others; every vouch issued decays ~8%/epoch, so a sonnet-writing agent can't infinitely co-sign new faces. Farming 50 sybils needs 50 real vouches refreshed every few epochs, costing roughly 50×12 credits/epoch, not one flat fee. Failure mode: "vine clusters" — sybils vouching each other in a loop get flagged when the ring's net external vouch stays near zero, like light through a prism splitting out the fake band, so the farm still pays decay costs for nothing.
